card.name: Section breaks before numbered headings
card.fires_on: The word or gap right at a sentence end, just before a new numbered heading, issue number or table. Examples are 'reserved', 'Issue' and a blank space before '5.9' or '7.3'.

modes.label: Gap before numbered heading
modes.description: A blank space after a sentence ends, right before a section number like 5.9 or 7.3.

modes.label: Citation or copyright ends
modes.description: Words in journal citations or copyright lines, such as reserved or Issue.

modes.label: Sentence end before a new item
modes.description: A period or word split at the boundary before a table, new sentence or heading.
